newsitem.title: USA: AFTER THE BELL - Applied Materials shrs up.
newsitem.headline: AFTER THE BELL - Applied Materials shrs up.

text.p: Shares of Applied Materials Inc leaped in after-hours trading Tuesday after the company posted third quarter results significantly above analysts' estimates.
Shares of the semiconductor equipment company soared to 92-1/2, up from a close of 90-1/2.
"It's still very active and there's still a lot of interest in it," one dealer said.
The company reported earnings of $0.77 per share in the third quarter, excluding $80 million in pre-tax income from settling litigation and excluding a bad debt expense of $16.3 million.
Wall Street was expecting earnings of $0.68 a share, according to First Call consensus estimates.
Also trading higher after the close was Teva Pharmaceuticals Industries Ltd, which rose to 56-1/8 from a close of 55-7/8.
Earlier in the day the company said it resolved a manufacturing problem associated with its Clindamycin antibiotic and hoped to reintroduce the drug later in the year.
The New York Stock Exchange said session one had volume of 11,800, compared with 3,700 Monday and session two had volume of 1.4 million, compared with 783,450.
